items.reason: Gap 0 describes concurrent deliveries of the same event both bypassing the check because the set is updated only after processing.
Gap 1 describes replaying a webhook with a modified unsigned X-Event-Id header to bypass de-duplication.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler expects refund.created, so refunds miss it.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
